title: Who Are the 9 Muses of Greek Mythology?
skills: identify the nine Muses and their traditional domains
connect mythological figures to literature and the arts
recognize classical allusions involving the Muses
analyze how mythology influences literary and artistic traditions
alignment_note: Introduces the nine Muses of Greek mythology and their traditional associations with poetry, history, music, drama, and other arts. Supports classical-literature study, mythological allusions, cultural literacy, and analysis of artistic inspiration across high school English courses.
